meta.title: Index definitions: SOFR, €STR, EURIBOR 3M / 6M
meta.description: Name, currency, kind (overnight | term), day count, fixing calendar, fixing / publication lag and the publication convention of each index. Interpreted by include/epykos/conventions/registry.hpp; the research is docs/G4_BUNDLE.md sections USD.2 and EUR.2.
sources: FRBNY, Secured Overnight Financing Rate Data / Additional Information about Reference Rates (publication at approximately 8:00 a.m. ET on the next business day; actual/360)
ECB, Euro short-term rate (€STR) page and methodology (published each TARGET2 business day for the previous business day's transactions, three decimals)
EMMI, EURIBOR (Act/360 the only official day count since 2018-12-03; tenors 1W, 1M, 3M, 6M, 12M)
Bloomberg SEF EUR EURIBOR swap submission 2013-09-30: 'The first Euribor Fixing Date is 2 Target business days prior to the Effective Date'
LCH Product Eligibility EUR (Oct 2019): EURIBOR fixing T-2, €STR fixing T+1

imported_from.imported_from: SwapEngine/conventions/conventions.json (D37 data import), indices.USD-SOFR, indices.EUR-ESTR, indices.EUR-EURIBOR-3M, indices.EUR-EURIBOR-6M
notes: Fed Funds (USD-FEDFUNDS) is not imported: Stage A has no Fed Funds instrument (PROBLEM.md section 4).

USD-SOFR.description: Secured Overnight Financing Rate, administered by the Federal Reserve Bank of New York.
USD-SOFR.publication: approximately 8:00 a.m. ET on the next U.S. Government Securities Business Day, for the previous business day (T+1); rounded to the nearest basis point
USD-SOFR.administrator: Federal Reserve Bank of New York

sources.day_count: FRBNY Additional Information: 'actual number of calendar days, but assuming a 360-day year'
sources.publication: FRBNY SOFR page: 'Each business day, the New York Fed publishes the SOFR on the New York Fed website at approximately 8:00 a.m. ET'; ISDA 2026-03-27 guidance: 'SOFR is published on a T+1 basis and the rate for a given day is published at 8:00 a.m., New York City time, on the following U.S. Government Securities Business Day'
sources.fixing_calendar: FRBNY Additional Information: published every business day including SIFMA early closes, not on or for SIFMA full closes; Good Friday 2026 exception per NY Fed operating policy 260312a (calendar USD-SOFR)
sources.rounding: FRBNY Additional Information: volume-weighted median 'rounded to the nearest basis point'

EUR-ESTR.description: Euro short-term rate, administered by the European Central Bank.
EUR-ESTR.publication: 08:00 CET on each TARGET2 business day, for the previous TARGET2 business day (T+1); three decimal places (the March 2021 methodology text says 'no later than 09:00 CET')

sources.publication: ECB €STR page: 'published on each TARGET2 business day based on transactions conducted and settled on the previous TARGET2 business day' (rate shown at 08:00 on 2026-09-23 for reference date 2026-09-22); ECB €STR methodology and policies: 'The ECB publishes the euro short-term rate with three decimal places no later than 09:00 CET on the next TARGET2 business day'
sources.day_count: ACT/360: TP ICAP EUR OIS MET template (2021 ISDA Definitions), 'Floating Rate Day Count Fraction: ACT/360'; OpenGamma Strata EUR_FIXED_1Y_ESTR_OIS 'Both legs ... use day count Act/360'
sources.fixing_calendar: ECB methodology: 'The rate is published for each TARGET2 business day'
sources.rounding: ECB methodology: 'volume-weighted trimmed mean rounded to the third decimal'

EUR-EURIBOR-3M.publication: 11:00 CET on each TARGET business day, for value two TARGET days later

sources.day_count: EMMI press release 2018-11-28: 'Euribor under its official Act/360 day count convention is not affected ... and will continue to be published' (Act/365 and 30/360 variants discontinued 2019-03-31)
sources.fixing_lag: Bloomberg SEF EUR EURIBOR swap submission (2013-09-30): 'The first Euribor Fixing Date is 2 Target business days prior to the Effective Date'; LCH Product Eligibility EUR (2019): EURIBOR 'Fixing T-2'
sources.publication: EMMI Euribor methodology: publication at 11:00 CET - UNVERIFIED by fetch (harvested EMMI methodology text does not state the time in the extracted pages)

EUR-EURIBOR-6M.publication: 11:00 CET on each TARGET business day, for value two TARGET days later
